hypotheses.name: Confidence-stratified community enrichment
hypotheses.method: Built immune scGPT kNN community graphs (3 seeds x 12 layers x source/target-disjoint splits), stratified edges by DoRothEA confidence tier, and tested tier-monotonic AUROC slope with 400 tier-label permutations per seed-layer-split.
hypotheses.result_value: source=-0.0771, target=-0.0627; positive-slope layers 0/12 in both splits
hypotheses.next_action: Run one rescue with independent confidence anchors (e.g., STRING tiers) and prevalence-adjusted effect sizes; otherwise retire this monotonic-confidence branch.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model Procrustes/OT transfer
hypotheses.method: Aligned matched scGPT and Geneformer gene embeddings by domain (immune/lung/external_lung) using supervised Procrustes and unsupervised Hungarian OT; evaluated top-1 retrieval, kNN neighborhood transfer, and transferred-edge AUROC versus 300 random-map nulls/domain.
hypotheses.result_value: 0.5650 mean across domains (3/3 significant vs null); OT top1=0.0024 and non-significant
hypotheses.next_action: Keep map-aware transfer branch active and run a materially changed unsupervised alignment rescue (Sinkhorn or CCA-warm-start OT) with the same null protocol.

hypotheses.name: Local reconstruction-error mechanistic screen
hypotheses.method: Computed per-gene local linear reconstruction errors on immune scGPT embeddings (3 seeds x 12 layers x 2 splits), aggregated to edge features, tested edge-label signal with 400 label permutations/row, and coupled row-level metrics to H13 geodesic lift using 3000 layer permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: source=0.5331 (Fisher p=5.64e-23), target=0.4780 (Fisher p~1.0); target coupling to H13 mean rho=-0.4079 (p=0.0190)
hypotheses.next_action: Recast as inverse-coupling hypothesis and replicate across lung/external-lung before promoting or retiring.
